summary: Put on every dropped/thrown entity once the dropper's action resources were spent (born in 'shove-throw'). Written by esv::drop::DropEntityExecuteSystem::ProcessWaitingForActionResourceSpending from the dropper's esv::drop::DropEntityStateComponent.

fields.name: Dropper
fields.evidence: ProcessWaitingForActionResourceSpending (EoCServer.dll+0x9B4590): for each alive entity of the dropper's DropEntitiesListComponent adds this component (FUN_1809b22a0) and sets +0 to the query entity (the one holding DropEntityStateComponent). Live: entity handles 0x00800011_000007C3 / 0x01800001_00018D04. Windows save loader bg3.exe+0x25E2F90 stores the EntityHandle converted from the saved EntityId (bg3.exe+0x4018730) at +0.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: Same function: +8 = state+0x10 (8 bytes), +0x10 = state+0x18. Live floats identical to DropEntityStateComponent.Position. Loader bg3.exe+0x25E2F90 stores the level-transformed vec3 (bg3.exe+0x2772030) at +8 (8 bytes) and +0x10 (4).

fields.name: Rotation
fields.evidence: Value storage of an ls::Optional<Quaternionf>: Windows save loader bg3.exe+0x25E2F90 (model ls::model::game::drop::v1::DropEntityTargetComponent, 48 bytes) stores the level-rotated quaternion (bg3.exe+0x27744C0) at +0x14..+0x23 only when the model's flag is set, otherwise the bytes stay uninitialised (raw check: 'not an ordinary float'); hence std::array<float, 4>, not glm::quat. ProcessWaitingForActionResourceSpending copies state+0x1C..+0x2B here.

fields.name: HasRotation
fields.evidence: +0x24 = state+0x2C (4-byte copy; first byte is the Optional flag). Live 0. Loader bg3.exe+0x25E2F90: 4-byte store at +0x24 whose low byte is 1 only when the rotation was loaded.

fields.name: field_28
fields.evidence: Byte +0x28 = a local flag that is 0 for the first alive entity of the list and 1 for every following one (local_2e8). Live 0 (one entity per throw); bytes +0x29.. are 0xFF garbage. Loader bg3.exe+0x25E2F90: 4-byte store at +0x28 whose low byte is (model byte +0x14 != 0) - a saved bool.

open_questions: Meaning of the bool at +0x28 (0 for the first alive entity of the dropper's list, 1 for the rest); the savegame model has no member names.
second_pass: All offsets and widths confirmed by the Windows save loader bg3.exe+0x25E2F90 (EntityHandle +0, vec3 +8, optional quaternion +0x14 with flag +0x24, saved bool +0x28). Rotation is now std::array<float, 4> because the optional's storage is left uninitialised when unset, which made the raw check fail on glm::quat.
raw_check: 14 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
